label: Finite interpretations for the fourteen derivations of round 2: for each premise other than…
paraphrase: Finite interpretations for the fourteen derivations of round 2 (existence and act): for each premise other than excluded middle, a one-element (or two-respect) model in which the other premises hold and the conclusion fails, and one joint model in which a thought occurs, its bearer exists, exercises intellect, opines, causes and is in act of esse, and every premise and conclusion of the batch holds. Satisfiability and omission only; no model is claimed to describe reality.
